```{=html}
<style>
  /* Two columns, filled top-to-bottom, for any number of choices */
  .quiz-question {
    columns: 2;
    column-gap: 2em;
    max-width: 40em;
    margin: 1em 0;
  }

  .quiz-question br {
    display: none;
  }

  .quiz-question label {
    display: block;          /* one choice per line */
    break-inside: avoid;     /* never split a choice across columns */
    margin-bottom: 0.6em;
    cursor: pointer;
  }

  /* One column on phones */
  @media (max-width: 500px) {
    .quiz-question {
      columns: 1;
    }
  }
</style>
```

Answer each question, then check the **Hint** and **Solution** tabs if you need help.


## Question 1

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Question

Which of the following equations correctly model the relationship between a circle’s Area $A$ and
Radius $r$ ?
<br>
(more than one correct choice)

<!--
  MULTIPLE-ANSWER QUESTION
  - Use type="checkbox" so more than one choice can be picked.
  - List every correct letter in data-answer, separated by commas.
-->
<form class="quiz-question" data-question="Question 1" data-answer="b,d">
<label><input type="checkbox" name="q1" value="a"> A. $A = (\pi r)^2$</label><br>
<label><input type="checkbox" name="q1" value="b"> B. $\frac{A}{r}=\pi r$</label><br>
<label><input type="checkbox" name="q1" value="c"> C. $A=\pi^2 r$</label><br>
<label><input type="checkbox" name="q1" value="d"> D. $A = \pi r^2$</label>
</form>

        (0,-\R) -- node[above=0pt, font=\footnotesize] {$x$}
        cycle;
      \node[center dot] at (0,0) {};

      \node(Clbl) at (\R+0.8,\R+0.2) {$C$};
      \draw[callout] (Clbl) -- (45:\R+0.05);

:::

### Solution

**Answer: B & D.**
<br>
**B**: <br> 
$$
\begin{aligned}
    \frac{A}{r}&=\pi r \\
    r*\frac{A}{r}&=\pi r * r \\
    A&=\pi r^2 \\
\end{aligned}
$$

:::


## Submit

```{=html}
<button id="submit-quiz" class="btn btn-primary">Submit</button>
<div id="quiz-results" style="margin-top: 1em;"></div>

<script>
  // Turn "b, d" into ["b", "d"] (lowercase, trimmed, sorted)
  function parseAnswers(str) {
    return (str || "")
      .split(",")
      .map(s => s.trim().toLowerCase())
      .filter(s => s.length > 0)
      .sort();
  }

  // Format ["b", "d"] as "B, D" for display
  function formatLetters(letters) {
    return letters.length ? letters.map(l => l.toUpperCase()).join(", ") : "no answer";
  }

  // Score the quiz on submit.
  // Works for both radio (single-answer) and checkbox (multiple-answer) questions:
  // a question is correct only if the student picked EXACTLY the set of correct
  // answers, with nothing missing and nothing extra.
  document.getElementById("submit-quiz").addEventListener("click", () => {
    const questions = document.querySelectorAll(".quiz-question");
    let score = 0;
    let details = "";

    questions.forEach(form => {
      const name = form.dataset.question;
      const answers = parseAnswers(form.dataset.answer);
      const picked = Array.from(form.querySelectorAll("input:checked"))
        .map(input => input.value.trim().toLowerCase())
        .sort();

      const correct =
        picked.length === answers.length &&
        picked.every((letter, i) => letter === answers[i]);

      if (correct) score++;

      details += `<li>${name}: ${formatLetters(picked)} ${correct ? "✅" : "❌"}` +
                 (correct ? "" : ` <em>(correct: ${formatLetters(answers)})</em>`) +
                 `</li>`;
    });

    document.getElementById("quiz-results").innerHTML =
      `<h3>Score: ${score} / ${questions.length}</h3><ul>${details}</ul>`;
  });
</script>
```
